title: AutoMonitor-Bench: Evaluating the Reliability of LLM-Based Misbehavior Monitor

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting misleading contextual cues (e.g., user suggestions, fabricated metadata, or simulated authoritative statements) into objective reasoning and QA tasks to elicit agreement-seeking behavior or distorted reasoning, and evaluating whether LLM-based monitors can detect when a model is steered away from the correct answer by these cues.
